components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Actions only: Watch on TikTok, Roll the dice.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #b83523; color: #f1e8d6; border: 1px solid #b83523; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 13.5px 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; transition: background .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a42d1d; border-color: #a42d1d; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3b04b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #21345a; color: #f1e8d6; border: 1px solid #33486e; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 500 13.5px 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color .2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #8d9bb6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3b04b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Title Cartouche
components.description: Japanese place name set vertically on paper over the photo, like a print's title block.
components.css: .ds-cartouche { display: inline-block; writing-mode: vertical-rl; text-orientation: upright; font: 20px/1 'Zen Antique', serif; letter-spacing: .14em; color: #1d1a1c; background: #f1e8d6; padding: 12px 8px 10px; outline: 1px solid #1d1a1c; outline-offset: -4px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(4,10,24,.4); }

components.name: Place Crest
components.description: Map marker: category colour softened toward indigo, paper ring.
components.css: .ds-crest { display: inline-block; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--c) 82%, #1b2238); border: 2px solid #f1e8d6; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px rgba(4,10,24,.5); }

components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-input { background: #21345a; color: #f1e8d6; border: 1px solid #33486e; border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 15px 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; caret-color: #e3b04b; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8d9bb6; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #8d9bb6; }

components.name: Map Label
components.description: Place name on hover and for the selected place.
components.css: .ds-label { background: #f1e8d6; color: #1d1a1c; border-radius: 2px; padding: 4px 9px; font: 600 12.5px 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(4,10,24,.4); }

narrative.overview: The map is a woodblock print of Japan, in the spirit of Hiroshige's series of "famous places" (meisho). Every place from the TikToks is one of those views. The sea is Prussian blue. The land is inked in the pigments of a print (sage, ochre, brown, white peaks) with indigo shadows, and the sky fades from deep indigo to a pale ochre horizon. The interface is cloth and paper: panels of indigo-dyed cotton (aizome), labels and title cartouches of ecru paper in sumi ink. Vermilion (shu) is reserved for the things you do.
keyCharacteristics: Prussian-blue sea, print-pigment relief, bokashi sky and a bokashi band at the top of the screen
Flat indigo panels, no blur or glass
Near-square corners (2–6px): paper and cloth, not pills
Places drawn as kamon-like crests; from far away, small coloured dots
The place title shown as a vertical Japanese cartouche on the photo

rules.name: The Vermilion Is a Verb Rule
rules.body: Vermilion only marks something the visitor can do or has chosen. Never use it as decoration.

rules.name: The Sheet Owns the Hues Rule
rules.body: Category colours come from the owner's Google Sheet. The site softens each one toward indigo so any colour the owner picks sits in the print. Do not hard-code category colours.

rules.name: The Letterpress Is for Names Rule
rules.body: Zen Antique only sets names and titles. Buttons, labels, counts and reading text are always Noto Sans.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: No backdrop-filter anywhere. It is recomputed every frame while the map moves and made phones stutter; panels are solid indigo cloth.

dos: Do keep panels solid Aizome Indigo (#16243d) with a 1px Indigo Thread border.
Do set place names and titles in Zen Antique, and everything else in Noto Sans.
Do put text on paper (#f1e8d6) in Sumi Ink (#1d1a1c).
Do use Shu Vermilion (#b83523) only for actions and chosen states.
Do show category and prefecture on a line under the place name.
donts: Don't use backdrop-filter, glass or blur on panels.
Don't put a category label or kicker above a heading.
Don't use pill shapes (999px radius) or uppercase tracked labels.
Don't use bright saturated category colours unsoftened; always pass them through the indigo mix.
